design_description: A classic football jersey combining deep forest green and black vertical stripes, separated by thin, vibrant yellow pinstripes. Matching yellow shoulder stripes, a black crewneck collar, and coordinated sleeves create a sharp, retro-inspired look. The front features a crowned black-and-yellow club crest and minimalist white Momuto branding. The back adopts a clean, solid green finish, with bold yellow PLAYER lettering and an oversized number 10 for maximum contrast and readability.
